_purpose: Re-entry conditions for EXECUTION-denylisted symbols. The alpha graveyard has recorded its re-entry conditions since L1.16a; the execution graveyard had none, and it is the one that most needed them: `_structurally_bleeding` blocks NEW OPENS, and `n` -- the trade count its own verdict is conditioned on -- can only grow through opens. So n freezes at the instant of the block and the verdict becomes unrevisitable by construction. A symbol is not re-admitted here; it is granted a bounded number of minimum-size PROBES so the verdict can be re-tested at all.
_default: DENY. A symbol absent from this file stays blocked exactly as before. A row with no named_change, no usable probe_after, or max_probes=0 is also denied -- recording a row is not arming it.

1000CATUSDT.named_change: Incident #6 fix (2026-07-27, run_cashcarry_executor.py:1235 _CLOSE_IS_MARKET_ONLY + :1255 reduceOnly on close legs). The original mechanism of death was THE DESK'S OWN BUG, not this symbol's microstructure: post-only closes carried neither reduceOnly nor a venue size cap, so repeated close attempts accumulated resting fills that bought the short through zero into a +1,138,985 LONG. The -74.6 bps over n=5 attributed to this symbol is contaminated by that event, and the bug that caused it no longer exists.
1000CATUSDT._probe_after_why: Deliberately AFTER the L1.38 launch window. A re-entry probe is a money-path IMPROVEMENT, not a repair, and the first 20 live fills are the ones that can never be re-randomised -- they should not be spent re-testing a contaminated verdict. Dated, not open-ended (an undated deferral is illegal).
1000CATUSDT.falsifier: If 3 probes at natural size still realise <= -20 bps, the verdict is RE-CONFIRMED on uncontaminated evidence and this row is set to max_probes=0 with that result recorded. The point is to make the verdict TESTABLE, never to overturn it.

NOMUSDT.named_change: THE MECHANISM OF DEATH WAS MIS-PRICING, and three named changes address it directly. (1) L1.11b REALISED-COST FLOOR: run_cashcarry_executor._rt_bps now returns max(modelled, realised), so this symbol is priced at its OWN realised round-trip instead of a book-walk that excludes fees -- the modelled figure that admitted these opens was slippage-only (BTCUSDT reads 0.018 bps, impossible with commission). (2) R0057 PER-SYMBOL ENTRY CONTRACT replaced the flat funding floor: funding over the minimum hold must beat THIS symbol's round-trip, not a desk-wide constant. (3) R0247 SIZE-AWARE LOOKUP prices the notional the open would actually send, which is the specific thing that was absent when NOMUSDT took $4,297 into a thin book on 2026-07-13. The desk did not learn these were bad symbols; it learned it could not see their cost. It can now. THIS IS THE 2026-07-13 DEAD-MAN SYMBOL -- $4,297 into a thin book, venue equity -40.9% in five minutes, and the executor's mark-based view showed only -$55. The $100 cap below is the whole point of the probe and is now ENFORCED in code; it was documentation only until 2026-08-13.
NOMUSDT._probe_after_why: Matches the two existing rows: deliberately AFTER the L1.38 launch window. A re-entry probe is a money-path IMPROVEMENT, not a repair, and the first 20 live fills can never be re-randomised. Dated, not open-ended -- an undated deferral is illegal.
